deployments_detail.use: Deep Brew, Starbucks' proprietary AI/ML platform (launched 2019) that powers customer personalization, drives store operations, labor allocation and inventory management across the chain. [Starbucks (in-house, on Microsoft Azure)]

Green Dot Assist, a generative-AI barista assistant on in-store iPads/tablets that gives conversational answers on drink recipes, seasonal ingredients, troubleshooting, shift planning and coaching, with video tutorials. [Microsoft Azure OpenAI]
deployments_detail.value: Pilot across 35 locations, with rollout to US/Canada stores planned for fiscal year 2026

deployments_detail.use: "Green Dot Assist" GenAI barista assistant (Microsoft) + "Deep Brew" AI for personalization/inventory

Computer-vision / spatial-intelligence inventory-counting tool that automated shelf/stock counts to prevent stockouts. Deployed across North America ~Sept 2025 and then discontinued in May 2026 after being deemed unreliable. [not disclosed (computer vision)]

Azure Sphere IoT connected-equipment program: sensors on espresso machines collect a dozen+ data points per shot to enable predictive maintenance and secure cloud delivery of recipes (replacing thumb-drive updates). [Microsoft Azure Sphere]
deployments_detail.value: More than 5 megabytes of data generated per machine in an eight-hour shift

deployments_detail.use: AI-driven labor scheduling / staffing optimization (part of Deep Brew) that automates store scheduling grids and supports 'Green Apron Service' by placing the right partners at the right times. [Starbucks (Deep Brew)]
Machine-learning demand and food/inventory forecasting models used to improve inventory accuracy and food availability across stores. [Starbucks (Deep Brew)]

Reinforcement-learning recommendation engine in the Starbucks mobile app that generates tailored order suggestions based on local store inventory, weather, time of day, community preferences and past orders. [Microsoft Azure]
deployments_detail.value: 16 million active Starbucks Rewards members receiving personalized suggestions

deployments_detail.use: Beta Starbucks app inside ChatGPT that lets customers discover drinks from a mood, 'vibe', text prompt or photo, then pick a store, customize and hand off the order to the Starbucks app or Starbucks.com for checkout. [OpenAI (ChatGPT)]
Predictive drive-thru ordering: AI-driven digital menu boards that make order recommendations using store transaction histories and 400+ store-level criteria. [Microsoft Azure]
deployments_detail.value: more than 400 store-level criteria used for recommendations
